notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Pandemonium triggers, dealing damage to an opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding one mana of any colour.
Resolve the Pandemonium trigger, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 3.
